kind: P2 additional static source evidence; implementation/testing not performed
scope: Resolve known status.stats fields without altering the frozen P2_BACKEND_CONTRACT_EVIDENCE.json or any backend source.
count_validation: Nonnegative finite integer when present; missing/invalid stays unknown. GCLI has no AG quota counters. permanent_disabled presence differs by storage engine; do not fabricate omitted fields.
quota_next_expiry: Nonnegative finite epoch-seconds timestamp, may have fractions; 0 means no recorded upcoming expiry. It is not a credential count and must not use integer-only count normalization. Treat missing/invalid unknown. Display reset time only; it cannot clear quota protection.
scope_semantics: stats.total/normal/disabled/permanent_disabled are server aggregate fields; response.total is the filtered list match count and items is a page. Never derive global counters from items.

in_cooldown/no_cooldown count enabled credentials according to actual backend semantics, not all total credentials. AG quota_restricted/unrestricted/blocked_unknown/state_invalid count eligible enabled credentials once. Preserve backend distinctions between engines rather than recompute client-side.
quota_next_expiry may consider candidate rows excluded by list filters/disabled conditions according to source engine. It is the server aggregate deadline, not a grant to retry or release protection.

AG model_access_summary.total is the base filtered set before the chosen family status filter; family_counts are supported/unavailable/unknown for each returned known family; counts expose existing tier-compatible family counts and checked_at is epoch seconds. It is not necessarily the node-wide all-credentials total.
Credential cycle_stats/last_cycle_stats are per-row metadata, not global cycles. Restore their display in credentials; do not invent overview cycle cards or aggregate first page.
Additional unknown stats keys remain unknown and must not be copied wholesale into safe model state. All normalization remains allowlisted. No actual credentials/database/runtime were inspected.

creds_list = []
    for summary in result["items"]:
        cred_info = {
            "filename": os.path.basename(summary["filename"]),
            "user_email": summary["user_email"],
            "disabled": summary["disabled"],
            "error_codes": summary["error_codes"],
            "error_classifications": summary.get("error_classifications", {}),
            "last_success": summary["last_success"],
            "backend_type": backend_type,
            "model_cooldowns": summary.get("model_cooldowns", {}),
            "tier": summary.get("tier") or default_tier_for_mode(mode),
            "success_count": summary.get("success_count", 0),
            "failure_count": summary.get("failure_count", 0),
            "cycle_stats": summary.get("cycle_stats", {}),
            "last_cycle_stats": summary.get("last_cycle_stats", {}),
            "remark": summary.get("remark", ""),
        }

        if mode == "geminicli":
            cred_info["tier_raw_id"] = summary.get("tier_raw_id")
            cred_info["tier_raw_name"] = summary.get("tier_raw_name")
            cred_info["tier_detected_at"] = summary.get("tier_detected_at")
            for field in ("health_status", "quarantine_reason", "probe_stage", "next_probe_at",
                          "last_health_check_at", "health_check_started_at", "health_state_version",
                          "permanent_disabled"):
                cred_info[field] = summary.get(field)

        if mode == "geminicli":
            cred_info["preview"] = summary.get("preview", True)
        else:
            cred_info.update(email_annotations.get(cred_info["filename"], {}))
            cred_info["permanent_disabled"] = summary.get("permanent_disabled", False)
            cred_info["enable_credit"] = summary.get("enable_credit", False)
            cred_info["model_access_state"] = summary.get("model_access_state", {})
            if supports_family_filter:
                cred_info["model_access_families"] = summary.get("model_access_families", {})
            if supports_group_filter:
                cred_info["quota_groups"] = summary["quota_groups"]
                cred_info["quota_state_invalid"] = summary["quota_state_invalid"]

        creds_list.append(cred_info)

    panel_caps = list(credential_caps) + [f"{mode}.quota.summary"] + list(panel_operation_capabilities(mode))
    if mode == "antigravity":
        panel_caps += ([GROUP_FILTER_CAPABILITY] if supports_group_filter else [])
        panel_caps += (["antigravity.model_access.family_filter"] if supports_family_filter else [])
        panel_caps += [SEARCH_CAPABILITY]
        panel_caps += ([AUTO_EMAIL_CAPABILITY] if email_enrichment_service.supports(storage_adapter._backend) else [])
    elif supports_search:
        panel_caps += [GEMINICLI_SEARCH]

    return JSONResponse(content={
        "mode": mode,
        "items": creds_list,
        "total": result["total"],
        "offset": offset,
        "limit": limit,
        "has_more": (offset + limit) < result["total"],
        "stats": result.get("stats", {"total": 0, "normal": 0, "disabled": 0}),
        **({"model_access_summary": result["model_access_summary"]} if mode == "antigravity" else {}),
        "panel_capabilities": panel_caps,
    })
